scope: v5.0 people PILOT (ART-NPC): m1 and f1 in uniform_engineering and casual_a, 6 new clips. Blender evidence, provisional: art/people/people_closeup.png (1.5 m, 3 angles), people_outfits.png, people_faces.png, people_clips.png; assets/models/people_m1.glb, people_f1.glb, people_manifest.json, npc_pairs.json; docs/progress/ART-NPC.md (v5). Rubric v5_rubrics.md 3.1-3.3. Judged strictly against Paul's 'stunningly modelled' aim (0.80-0.90 at 1.5 m).

what_works: Proportions are human and the two variants differ in height (1.80 / 1.68 m), face shape, hair and skin.
Modelled features exist: eyes with iris and highlight, brows, nose, lips with a lip line, ears, eyelids, a jaw bone for talk and laugh, five-finger hands.
Triangle budget holds (m1 11.8 k, f1 15.8 k of 24 k LOD0); +2.91 MB.
faults: Faces read as mannequins at 1.5 m: flat planes, no cheekbone or brow ridge form, no nasolabial fold, lips painted on a flat mouth area, a hard blocky jaw line. The maker says so; I agree.
f1's eyes are too large and saturated blue with a white sclera ring all round, under a low stern brow: a startled stare that leans uncanny (people_faces f1 front, 3/4).

Hair is a solid helmet with a hard jagged hairline on m1 (a stair-step edge where the hair cap meets the forehead) and flat planar cards with visible gaps on f1's bob; the strand texture is a stretched wood-grain look.
Jagged edges where parts meet: the neck base in the profile view, the tee neckline (a zig-zag edge), the hairline. These read as unfinished at 1.5 m.
Laugh: the open mouth is a dark hole with ragged lip edges; no teeth read (people_faces m1 and f1 laugh).
Hands: one open pose with splayed straight fingers in every idle frame; they read as mannequin hands.
Shading: flat untextured skin (no subtle colour variation, no normal detail), so faces look like painted plastic.

what_works: uniform_engineering reads as a work coverall: stand collar, zip line, chest pockets, belt with pouches, the amber department stripe across the chest and sleeves.
casual_a reads as off-duty (tee, jeans, trainers) and differs from the uniform at the room camera.
Outfits are separate skinned meshes on the shared rig (manifest).
faults: No cloth form: no folds at elbows, knees or waist (V5 section 1 asks for them); the fabric is a smooth tube. The coverall reads as a hard shell.
Uniform shoulders are blocky pads that sit above the arm; the tee sleeves are round puffed balloons (maker's note, confirmed on both variants).
f1 casual_a: navy tee and navy jeans in the same colour read as one onesie; the seat and hips bulge behind (outfits az 150/240).
Pockets and pouches are flat boxes stuck on the surface; the belt is a plain band.
The tee neckline edge is ragged (zig-zag) on both variants.

what_works: Six new clips read at the room camera: talk_gesture_a, laugh (head back, hand to chest), argue (open-hand gestures), hug as a pair, sit_bar_stool, dance_a.
Technical checks: npc_verify 441/0, npc_check 165 PASS, max step 14.48 deg after the hand-direction fix; blink and jaw overlays.
The hug meets: arms round backs, heads beside each other, clean enter and exit.
faults: Hug: bodies overlap more than 2 cm at the hold (maker: 144 vertices), and f1's right hand shows a raised thumb behind m1's back (reads as a thumbs-up). The v5 rubric hard check is 'no partner body through the other'.
Idle arm line: arms hang 25-30 deg out from the body with splayed hands in every clip's rest (the v3 round-1 A-pose fault is back on the new bodies).
Gestures are small and symmetrical; argue and talk look alike at game size; dance_a is a gentle sway (knees and hips barely move).

procedural_ceiling.question: Can the procedural (script-built) approach reach 0.80-0.90 at 1.5 m?
procedural_ceiling.answer: No, not in my judgement. With the fixes below it can reach about 0.65-0.72 (an acceptable stylised crowd). 0.80+ at 1.5 m needs sculpted form (cheekbones, brow ridge, eyelid folds, lip volume, cloth folds) and authored textures (skin colour variation, normal maps, hair cards with alpha), which primitive-based scripts do not produce. The realistic routes are (a) a hand-sculpted and retopologised base head and body per sex, made once and varied by shape keys, or (b) a licensed stylised base mesh or an AI generator (for example the Meshy pipeline Paul uses in town-sim) - both are outside V5 section 0 ('no downloads, no installs') and need Paul's decision.
procedural_ceiling.recommendation: Orchestrator: raise a decision-needed task for Paul: accept a procedural stylised look near 0.70, or allow one authored or generated base mesh per sex (and say which source) to aim at 0.80+.

fixes.subject: people_closeup
fixes.fix: Faces: add form with shape keys or sculpt displacement: a cheekbone plane, brow ridge, nasolabial fold, chin and jaw curve; lips with volume (upper lip overhang, lower lip shadow). Reduce f1's iris to about 45% of the eye opening, warm the blue, show less sclera, and lift the brows 2 mm to a neutral expression.

fixes.subject: people_closeup
fixes.fix: Hair: cards with alpha strands for the edge (a soft hairline) over a cap; no stair-step edge. Break f1's bob into 12-16 cards with a slight curl at the ends and a darker root; m1 crop with a fade at the sides.

fixes.subject: people_closeup
fixes.fix: Weld and smooth every seam: neck base, hairline, tee neckline. No visible jagged edge at 1.5 m.

fixes.subject: people_closeup
fixes.fix: Skin: bake subtle colour variation (warmer cheeks, nose and ears, cooler jaw), a faint pore or noise normal, and ambient occlusion in the eye sockets and under the nose.

fixes.subject: people_closeup
fixes.fix: Mouth interior: upper and lower teeth rows and a tongue, with a dark gradient behind; clean lip edges when open.

fixes.subject: people_closeup / people_animation
fixes.fix: Hands: a relaxed idle pose (fingers curled 15-30 deg, thumb in) and a fist, a point and a grip; arms 8-10 deg from the body in idle (the v3 rule).

fixes.subject: people_outfits
fixes.fix: Cloth folds: modelled folds at elbow, knee, waist and armpit (3-5 fold ridges each), a sleeve hem with thickness; replace the uniform shoulder pads with a set-in sleeve seam and the tee balloon sleeves with a fitted sleeve.

fixes.subject: people_outfits
fixes.fix: f1 casual_a: tee and jeans in different values (for example a light top over dark jeans), a visible waistband, reduce the rear hip volume.

fixes.subject: people_outfits
fixes.fix: Pockets and pouches with flaps and stitching lines; a belt with a buckle; a fabric roughness difference between canvas, knit and denim.

fixes.subject: people_animation
fixes.fix: Hug: fix the interpenetration to <= 2 cm at the hold and fold the thumb in. Make argue larger and asymmetric (a pointing hand, a lean in), and give dance_a hip and knee motion.
